description.value: A family-run neighbourhood café that has been caffeinating East Vancouver since 2003, The Laughing Bean is known for locally roasted coffee, fresh-baked pastries, and a dog-friendly patio on East Hastings Street. It is one of the few cafés in BC to accept Bitcoin and Lightning Network payments, alongside a full catering and online ordering service.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 48m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and active, confirming the café is operating under its online ordering and catering system. The site lists 'DOG FRIENDLY PATIO' and 'FREE PARKING' as features but makes no explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill. Phone (604-251-5282) and address (2695 East Hastings St) on the website match OSM exactly; the OSM check_date of 2026-02-22 is recent, further corroborating the business is open. A minor name discrepancy exists: OSM omits the leading 'The' used on the website.
concerns: Minor name discrepancy: OSM records 'Laughing Bean Coffee Co.' but the website title reads 'The Laughing Bean Coffee Co.' (OSM omits the leading 'The').
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating café with a verified website, recent OSM check date (2026-02-22), and online ordering — a useful stop for touring cyclists on East Hastings.

wow_evidence: family-run neighbourhood café that has been caffeinating East Vancouver since 2003
